truthBoundaries: The agent-mesh driver defaults to UberBond's existing runAgentMeshCycle through dynamic import; tests inject a contract-equivalent runner and therefore do not prove a real provider call.
A successful mesh cycle remains PENDING_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION and cannot be promoted to observed outcome by the runner itself.
A5/frontier selection returns an escalation requirement instead of becoming the routine implementation worker.
HANDOFF_SAVED, FLEET_RESUMED and UNATTENDED_OBSERVED remain separate evidence levels.
No external or business authority is created.
remainingBlocker: Gate 4 requires actual permitted non-frontier provider execution or a genuinely elapsed unattended interval plus independent receipts. This environment does not expose a callable cheaper-model provider, so fixtures cannot close it.
rollback: Revert PR #880 merge through the normal reviewed repository workflow.
